invariants.rationale: If an early return occurs when a node matches, 'result' is -1. Otherwise, node traversal decreases rowY and returns it.
'rowY' is only returned when none of the early exits happen, implying 'result' cannot exceed 'rowY'.
'nodes' is dereferenced and iterated in the loop, so it must not be null.
If an early return doesn't occur, 'result' (rowY) represents a decreasing y-position.
